resources.string: After dragging to an edge, the idle capsule tucks into a half circle. Tap it to show the capsule. Requests that need you stay fully visible.
Hide when the foreground app fills the screen with the status bar hidden; restore after fullscreen. Tasks and notifications continue. Off by default.
Open Mika and set up phone control to use the floating capsule.
In Android Quick Settings, tap Edit and add Floating capsule to switch it on or off. You can also use Mika Settings › Floating capsule.
